caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall-mounted box with a drawer. The box is constructed from brown wood and consists of several distinct sections: the upper part has a decorative backboard with two teardrop-shaped cutouts and curved edges at the top center, while the sides rise upwards before curving to meet the backboard. Below the open storage area at the top, there is a rectangular drawer with a round wooden knob in the middle, which is slightly ajar. The texture and grain of the wood are visible. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or elements. In the lower right corner, the name "CHRIS MAKRENOS" is written in red capital letters.
title: Comb Box
